PAIS Departmental Scholarship 2022, University of Warwick is an initiative by the Department of Politics and International Studies (PAIS), the University of Warwick for students commencing M.A. study in Autumn 2022. The selected student will receive an award of up to GBP 10,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be interested in pursuing PAIS taught MA programmes, including the double degrees
Have applied to the university and have paid their application fee no later than 15 April 2022 (
The applicant must have submitted the application to the MA programme before submitting the scholarship application.)
Have obtained an offer from the university before taking up the award
candidates can apply concurrently to other funding sources; however, successful candidates who receive major tuition funding elsewhere will be disqualified.

Part-time candidates will be considered; successful part-time awards will be distributed evenly across both years of study (eg, £2,500 each year for a Home candidate).

A case for support demonstrating why the applicant fits the specified criteria as well as reflecting the motivations for choosing to do a postgraduate degree in the specialisation (not more than 600 words)
- It should differ from the statement of purpose submitted with the application to the university.)
